strongest_verified: For each fixed finite integer r >= 0, on C and S², smooth complete K > 0 metrics converge in C^r while their actual point-normalized map factors fail C^(r+1) convergence. The full r=1 nonlinear operator and annulus are controlled.
exact_remaining_scope_issue: An authenticated earlier manuscript published on 30 September 2026 already states the same geometric result and contains the critical convex-radius correction. No new mathematical strengthening was established here.
